mapper.select: SELECT * FROM community_post ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM community_post WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND audit_status = 1 ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM community_post WHERE id IN #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE community_post SET like_count = IFNULL(like_count, 0) + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE community_post SET like_count = IFNULL(like_count, 0) - 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND like_count > 0
UPDATE community_post SET dislike_count = IFNULL(dislike_count, 0) + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE community_post SET comment_count = IFNULL(comment_count, 0) + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE community_post SET comment_count = IFNULL(comment_count, 0) - 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND comment_count > 0
UPDATE community_post SET audit_status = #{auditStatus}, audit_reply = #{auditReply} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE community_post SET collect_count = IFNULL(collect_count, 0) + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE community_post SET collect_count = IFNULL(collect_count, 0) - 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND collect_count > 0
